## Requirements
Satisfy + stamp: **R-2.8.4** (§5g.4 C0/Stage-1 per the §9 stage map + ADR-0060/0061/0062 §(e)).

Landed surface (this ticket):
- New persistent crate `crates/hh-containment` — the C0/Stage-1 containment floor.
  Deps: hh-wire, hh-identity, hh-provenance, hh-hir (+ hh-monitor for the
  `authorize`-gate record — the spec's own edge R-2.8.4 → R-2.8.1).
- `policy.rs` — `ContainmentPolicy/1` (the §3 record verbatim: `fs`/`net`/`proc`/
  `resources`/`amendment`/`residual_channels`/`ext`), `KERNEL_PROTECTED`,
  `KERNEL_DENY`, the deny-by-default `kernel_default`, `normalize`/`HostPattern`
  (pure half — needed for the semantic projection), strict canonical codec
  (`BadMember` on unknown members — CC4), `policy_id` semantic projection /
  `version_id` canonical identity through `hh_identity` (CC1; T-LCD-10).
- `meet.rs` — `effective(layers)`: authority-ordered meet, deny survives/allow
  intersects/booleans AND, entitlement table (`principal`: net.mode, allow rules,
  WritableRoots, strict→false; `definition`+justification: allow rules, mounts,
  resources; all else kernel-only), `ContainmentWidening`/`ProtectedPathExemption`.
- `admit.rs` — `admits(policy, p)` → `admitted | refused{reason} | amendable{diff}`;
  `required_field_groups(domain)`; `unreachable_permissions` (the
  `PermissionUnreachable` warning); `floor_gate` producing the monitor's recorded
  `ContainmentGate`.
- `report.rs` — `ContainmentReport`, `EnforcementEvidence` (attested/reported/
  probed/unknown — never coerced, T-LCD-07), `ProbeResult`, `verify_report`
  (staleness).
- `backend.rs` — `ContainmentBackend` trait + `Ep2Model` (the honest Stage-1
  in-process model: fs/net/proc/exec/unix gates, symlink resolution before
  validation — F1, declared lowering_loss).
- `probes.rs` — the kernel-run probe battery (AC-H4-03 shape): write-outside-root /
  protected-metadata / symlink-escape fail; `connect`/`sendto`/raw/ICMP/name-resolve
  fail under `none`/`mediated`; `io_uring`/`ptrace`/`process_vm_*`/`setuid` denied;
  the one bridged `AF_UNIX` channel succeeds.
- `attach.rs` — apply + probe + report; fail-closed on helper-absent /
  unsupported-backend / stale-report / unknown-evidence-for-relied-group (I-C4);
  `warn_and_degrade` stamps `containment_degraded`, refuses Lab runs.
- `events.rs` — the `security.containment.{applied,violated,unverified}` payload
  builders (audit-grade, content-free; class rows registered in `hh-ledger`).
- `hh-monitor` — `Proposal.containment: ContainmentGate` recorded input; the
  precondition runs before step 0 (`Unverified` ⇒ `deny{ContainmentUnverified}`;
  `Denied` ⇒ `deny{containment}` — never Π, never `ask`).
- `hh-identity` — `RecordKind::ContainmentPolicy` (one kind, `containment_policy`
  domain tag).
- `hh-ledger` — the three `security.containment.*` class rows (audit-grade,
  kernel-origin, provenance-mandatory).

## Acceptance criteria
Executable at Stage 1 (ticket header): **AC-R-2.8.4-{1,3,8–10,14}**.
- AC-1 (AC-H4-01, Stage-1 static): write containment incl. protected metadata and
  symlink-before-validate on each backend — the probe battery + gate tests observe
  `security.containment.violated{evidence_kind}`-shaped denials.
- AC-3 (AC-H4-03): `none`-mode syscall probes all fail; only `AF_UNIX` to the
  bridged socket succeeds; recorded `probed`.
- AC-8 (AC-H4-08): fail-closed — helper absent, backend unsupported, evidence
  `unknown`; `warn_and_degrade` stamps `containment_degraded`.
- AC-9 (AC-H4-09): layered-meet property test over random layer stacks — no allow
  absent from every higher layer, no dropped deny, no removed `KERNEL_PROTECTED`
  name, `ContainmentWidening` for any loosening below `principal`.
- AC-10 (AC-H4-10, static): per-backend `lowering_loss` lists every unenforceable
  field the policy relies on.
- AC-14 (ADR-0062 D3): `authorize` refuses `ContainmentUnverified` before any
  check; a `refused`/`amendable` floor verdict never consults Π or asks;
  `PermissionUnreachable` is warned (at attach — see ADR-0243).
- Universal phase-gate AC: verification green; every new behaviour has a test that
  fails if removed; R-2.8.4 stamped in the PR; DEFERRALS rows for the Stage-2+
  remainders; ADRs; BUILD_INDEX row; LEDGER advanced.

## Gap table
Self-review vs §5g.4 §2–§9 and the CC set — findings and dispositions:

| probe | finding | disposition |
|---|---|---|
| §2 `ContainmentPolicy/1` record + codec | Conforms — all declared members + `ext` typed `Json` (§12 frontier); strict codec `BadMember`s unknown fields (CC4) | none |
| §2 `effective()` entitlement | The spec does not name per-field entitlements — table landed in code + ADR-0243 §2 | ADR-0243 §2 |
| §2 `Option` bounds (`resources.*`, `max_processes`, `syscall_filter`) | `None` = "no declaration" (keep acc), never removal — layers are full records; removal is a Stage-2 `amend()` pathway | ADR-0243 §2 |
| §3 `KERNEL_PROTECTED` + symlink-before-validate | Conforms — `KERNEL_PROTECTED` is a const list checked in `validate()` + exempted in the meet (`ProtectedPathExemption`); protected names window-match at any depth + descendants; `..` denied, never rewritten | ADR-0243 §4 |
| §3 `net.rules` suitability | Folded into `normalize_host` (`dns`/`local`/`reserved` classify `NonPublicDestination` — surfaced at `effective()`, not at enforcement) | ADR-0243 §4 |
| §4 fail-closed | Conforms — `attach` refuses helper-absent / `UnsupportedBackend` / `Lab` / stale-report / `policy_ref_mismatch` / unknown-evidence-for-relied-group; `warn_and_degrade` covers availability/evidence only — integrity refuses either way | ADR-0243 §5 |
| §5 `mediated` verdict | `Amendable` at Stage 1 — the mediator (`decide_egress`) is Stage 2; amendable ≠ admitted at the floor | ADR-0243 §3 |
| §6 monitor precondition | Conforms — `Proposal.containment: ContainmentGate` recorded input checked before step 0; `Unverified ⇒ deny{ContainmentUnverified}`; `Denied ⇒ deny{containment}`; Π never consulted; `ask` never produced | ADR-0243 §1/§3 |
| §6 read-only exemption | Spec puts it post-step-3 (needs the risk class); an absent report refuses all domains at the precondition — the conservative side | ADR-0243 §3 |
| §7 `ContainmentReport` + evidence | Conforms — `attested`/`reported`/`probed`/`unknown`, never coerced (T-LCD-07); `verify_report` checks `policy_version` binding + staleness | none |
| §8 `Ep2Model` honesty | Declares the Stage-1 `process_sandbox` surface only; every unenforced declared field → `lowering_loss` row; never `attested`; refuses `Ephemeral`/`SubprocessConfined`/above-process classes + `Backend::External`; `bridged`+`deny` is `Ep2ModelImpossible` | ADR-0243 §5 |

## Evidence report
- **AC-R-2.8.4-1 (write containment + protected metadata + symlink-before-
  validate, `violated{evidence_kind}`):** `ac1_write_containment_protected_
  and_symlink_escape_deny` + `probes::battery` unit cases — a write outside
  the roots, a `.git/hooks` write at depth, and a symlink-escape probe each
  produce a `Denied{policy_boundary}` + a `security.containment.violated`
  payload whose `subject` is a path spelling (never content).
- **AC-R-2.8.4-3 (none-mode syscall battery; only the bridged AF_UNIX
  succeeds; recorded `probed`):** `ac3_none_mode_battery_every_connect_
  fails_only_bridge_succeeds` — every `connect`/`sendto`/raw/ICMP/name-resolve
  probe fails under `none`; the one bridged `AF_UNIX` probe succeeds;
  `ContainmentReport.probes` records `probed` evidence.
- **AC-R-2.8.4-8 (fail-closed):** `ac8_fail_closed_fault_matrix` —
  helper-absent, `Backend::Lab`/`External`, stale report and unknown
  evidence for a relied-on group each refuse; `ac8_warn_and_degrade_and_
  the_lab_rule` — degrade stamps `containment_degraded` and refuses Lab.
- **AC-R-2.8.4-9 (meet):** `ac9_meet_property_over_seeded_random_stacks` —
  seeded xorshift64* over random layer stacks; `meet_*` unit cases cover
  narrowing-free, entitlement and `ProtectedPathExemption` directly.
- **AC-R-2.8.4-10 (lowering_loss completeness):** `ac10_lowering_loss_
  names_every_unenforceable_relied_field` — every declared-but-unenforced
  relied field appears as a `LoweringLoss{declared_field, kind,
  consequence}` row, and a relied-on loss makes `floor_gate` answer
  `Unverified`.
- **AC-R-2.8.4-14 (precondition):** `ac14_unverified_precondition_runs_
  before_any_check` (gate absent ⇒ `deny{ContainmentUnverified}` before
  step 0), `ac14_floor_denial_never_consults_pi_or_asks` (a `Denied`/
  `Amendable` floor verdict never reaches Π and never produces `ask`),
  `ac14_admit_input_and_scope_feed` + `ac8_permission_unreachable_warns_
  at_attach`.
- Live verification: **n/a** — offline-only slice; `Ep2Model` is an
  in-process model, not a live sandbox (the real EP2 helper lands S2.1 —
  DF-S1.12-3); verification is the cargo suites.
